wholePhysicalScope: The named native OSM multipolygon places the mosque’s projecting portal, both corner cases, and open courtyard. Museum With No Frontiers documents the 120 by 113 m envelope and 78 by 66 m courtyard, agreeing with the named map geometry.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the distinct minaret crowns, open court and monumental west portal.
limitations: The standing exterior uses its mapped footprint and court opening. Roof levels, doorway recesses, ornamental spacing and the two minaret heights are estimated.

The mosque originally had three domes. The mapped and surveyed standing exterior is represented with the surviving central mihrab dome and raised corner bays. Courtyard bay counts and fountain dimensions are approximate.
The bordering Fatimid wall and the Bab al-Futuh city gate are separate subjects. The model includes only the mosque and its own structural envelope.
